# Retry queue incident

By Maya Patel

Parceline delivers webhooks to customer endpoints. On 17 June 2026, delivery of 18 notifications was delayed between 18:10 and 18:27 UTC. All 18 notifications were delivered after the retry queue recovered.

## Detection and response

Beacon, our service for detecting unusual delivery delays, compares each queue's delay with its five-minute rolling median. Its alert brought the backlog to our attention.

Jon Ellis inspected the queue while Maya Patel adjusted its retry limit. We used deliveryRefs, the public notification identifiers shown in the customer dashboard, to check the delayed notifications. For example, delivery example-123 now displays its completed delivery attempt.

## Recovery

We separated current delivery attempts from previous attempts. The Archive collection stores the previous attempts and their timestamps so customers can inspect the delivery history.

Back on track. We will keep the public status page updated if delivery delays return.
